      • setWwhObdDtcClass

        @PublishedMethod
void setWwhObdDtcClass(EWwhObdDtcClass wwhObdDtcClass)
        Setter for DTC class of WWH-OBD relevant events.

        If the Dem supports OBD and the legislation is set to WWH-OBD, the event (the DemDTCClass to be precise) must specify it's DTC Class. A value that differs from EWwhObdDtcClass.CLASS_NOCLASS specifies, that this event is relevant for WWH-OBD.

        Parameters:
        wwhObdDtcClass - The DTC class, which is necessary for WWH-OBD relevant events
